title: SF4312 (2023-2024 Regular): Standards for the safe storage of firearms and criminal penalties for failing to meet these standards establishment; appropriating money

provenance.fetched_by: Open States bulk data (Minnesota) (gun-policy Stage 5, Minnesota); operative text read by a Sonnet fill agent from the official Minnesota text (2nd Engrossment, 2024-04-24; official copy, https://www.revisor.mn.gov/bills/93/2024/0/SF/4312/versions/2/)
provenance.note: Version read: 2nd Engrossment, 2024-04-24. The bill strikes the old negligent-storage gross misdemeanor (child access) and replaces it. Section 2 appropriates $10,000 to the corrections commissioner for costs of this act (not quoted; tied to the bill's own penalties). Exceptions in subd. 3 (transport, shooting sports, peace officers, police stations) only partly quoted. Effective August 1, 2024. No passage vote recorded.
